definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese skill toy consisting of a handle (ken) with cups on either side and a spike on top, connected by a string to a ball (tama) with a hole. The objective is to catch the ball on the cups or spike through various tricks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→ころ：03091_koro⟧、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧けん{玉|だま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んだ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: I used to play with a kendama a lot when I was a child.

examples.japanese: けん{玉|だま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}している→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧。
⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、けん{玉|だま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

PARTS OF THE KENDAMA:
・⟦{剣|けん}→剣：11819_ken⟧ (ken) - the handle/spike portion
・⟦{玉|たま}→玉：02221_tama⟧ (tama) - the ball
・⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧ (sara) - the cups
・⟦{大皿|おおざら}→大皿：04477_oozara⟧ (large cup)
・⟦{小皿|こざら}→小皿：04476_kozara⟧ (small cup)
・⟦{中皿|ちゅうざら}→中皿：17754_chuuzara⟧ (base cup)
・⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧ (string)

BASIC TRICKS:
・⟦{大皿|おおざら}→大皿：04477_oozara⟧ (catching ball on large cup)
・⟦{小皿|こざら}→小皿：04476_kozara⟧ (catching ball on small cup)
・⟦{中皿|ちゅうざら}→中皿：17754_chuuzara⟧ (catching ball on base cup)
・⟦とめけん→とめけん：noentry⟧ (catching ball on spike)
・⟦もしかめ→もしかめ：noentry⟧ (alternating between cups)
・⟦{世界一周|せかいいっしゅう}→世界一周：noentry⟧ (around the world)

CULTURAL NOTES:
・Recognized as a traditional Japanese toy alongside ⟦お{手玉|てだま}→お手玉：06556_otedama⟧ and ⟦{竹馬|たけうま}→竹馬：06557_takeuma⟧
・Japan Kendama Association (⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧けん{玉|だま}⟦{協会|きょうかい}→協会：11831_kyoukai⟧) hosts certification levels
・Has gained international popularity with competitive tournaments
・Modern kendama culture merges traditional play with extreme sports influence
